name: ANTIGRAVITY Workflow API
description: OmniRoute workflow configuration for the AIRI dashboard (ops/dashboard-airi), the AIRI desktop app / VS Code plugin, and the avatar pipeline. Every value below was checked against the running gateway on 2026-09-10; UNVERIFIED routes say so.

auth.note: Read from C:/ANTIGRAVITY/.env by the dashboard server; the browser never holds the key. Since OmniRoute 3.8.50 even GET /models needs it.

image.note: The route validates against its own image-provider list. kilocode/google/*-image and kilocode/openai/gpt-5-image* are refused with 400 Invalid image model. Ask for response_format b64_json.

tts.status: UNVERIFIED — no speech credential configured on the gateway (owner action)

video.status: NOT AVAILABLE — no video model in the gateway catalog; /videos route UNVERIFIED

vrm.note: No .vrm exists in the repo; the viewer loads one from a file input only.

integrations.airi_desktop: AIRI 0.11.3 installer in OneDrive, intended for the Alienware node
